changelog: Restores canonical Jellyfin Live TV channel labels so the Guide receives the real channel number and name (for example, 1 and Disney Shorts instead of Channel 1 and - Disney Shorts). Adds text-only Guide readability polish: programme titles use 0.82em text with normal word wrapping and a two-line maximum, while channel number/name text uses 0.80em. The stock Jellyfin Guide geometry is intentionally unchanged: no row height, cell size, channel column width, spacing, logo size or positioning is modified. Scheduling, True Random weights, Standard TV, Personalized TV and playback behavior are unchanged.
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
name: Virtual TV
